text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After the Arima Kinen, we visit Kyoto<n>Racecourse at
Rice Shower's<n>request.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry to make you come all the way<n>to Kyoto
when there isn't even a<n>race, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry to make you come all the way<n>to Kyoto
when there isn't even a<n>race, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to burn this image into my<n>mind. This turf
I've raced on so much.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's packed full of precious memories.
choice_data_list:
Now that I think about it, this place was important to
you even before you debuted, huh?

Now that I think about it, this place was important to
you even before you debuted, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... yeah. Bakushin O and I came<n>here to watch
the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I saw McQueen here. She was just<n>like the blue
rose, and I wanted to be<n>like that too. I admired her
so much...
choice_data_list: And now you're a blue rose too.
And now you're a blue rose too.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Later, Mihono Bourbon declared them<n>to be rivals
here after the Kikuka Sho<n>as well.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And even with the previous spring<n>Tenno Sho
winner in front of her, she<n>didn't waver. She
bloomed<n>beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And then, there was the Takarazuka<n>Kinen, which
had everyone in despair<n>at first. But she was able
to share her<n>dream with everyone there.
choice_data_list:
Your story will be told for generations—just like the
fairytales in a book.

Your story will be told for generations—just like the
fairytales in a book.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What?! Y-you're making too big a<n>deal of me, Big
Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What?! Y-you're making too big a<n>deal of me, Big
Sister!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really, Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really, Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Hurry up, Mommy! I wanna go on the<n>slide first!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Be careful! You'll fall down if you<n>rush. And be sure
to take turns with<n>your friends.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...The slide?
choice_data_list: I think there's a park inside the racecourse.
I think there's a park inside the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really?! So that's why there are little<n>kids here—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-um! Big Brother? I think it's time<n>we head home.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-um! Big Sister? I think it's time we<n>head home.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well, what if starts raining because<n>I'm here and
the kids can't play<n>anymore?
choice_data_list: Nothing like that is going to happen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I checked the weather yesterday and<n>this morning.
Both times, it said there<n>was a zero percent chance
of rain<n>today. Besides, Rice Shower doesn't<n>bring
mis—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Let's play Rice Shower once we get<n>to the park! I
get to be Rice!

text_block_list.name: Garoto B
text_block_list.text:
No fair! I wanna be Rice Shower! I get<n>to be her
next!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Play... "Rice Shower"?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I've actually heard about this.<n>Recently, children
that like Rice<n>Shower have been playing games,
pretending to be her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: That said, I never thought I'd see it in<n>person.

text_block_list.name: Garoto C
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you the real Rice Shower?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-um, yes. That's me...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Really? You're the really real Rice?!<n>Oh my gosh!
Can I shake your hand?

text_block_list.name: Garoto C
text_block_list.text:
Hey, when are you gonna race next?<n>You're gonna
come back to Kyoto,<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, I... uhhh...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A crowd of rowdy children gather<n>around Rice
Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure this cycle of admiration will<n>continue. Just
like how Rice Shower<n>first admired Mejiro
McQueen, these<n>children now admire Rice Shower.
B-Big Brother?! Wh-wh-what should I<n>do?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Sister?! Wh-wh-what should I<n>do?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Not used to the attention of little kids,<n>Rice Shower's
brow furrows in<n>confusion. I try to help her out.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Okay, I see. So you just want me<n>to win
another race here?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'll be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll do my best to do that<n>for you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower reaches out her hand<n>and pats the
girl's head gently.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Even if my story isn't passed<n>down for
generations...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Even if my story isn't passed<n>down for
generations...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It seems like there will still be kids<n>who remember
me. I'm so, so lucky!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the smile on her face, the<n>admiration of
those children has<n>made Rice Shower very happy.

text_block_list.name: Garoto B
text_block_list.text:
Of course! You can't talk about Kyoto<n>racing without
mentioning Rice<n>Shower!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... What?!
choice_data_list: Do you all love Rice Shower?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: You bet! I wanna be just like her one<n>day!

text_block_list.name: Garoto C
text_block_list.text:
Me too! She's so cool, and she runs<n>so fast. I
wanna see her run here<n>again!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Eyes shining, the children gather<n>around Rice
Shower, waiting for what<n>the racer they admire so
much has to<n>say next.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, right...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely going to come back<n>here. I promise.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll run my heart out for you... and be<n>the first
across the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really! ...Hehe. Hey, Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really! ...Hehe. Hey, Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I've made another<n>precious memory
here, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
From now on—and forever ever<n>after—there will be
children that watch<n>her run and pin their hopes and
dreams on her.
